# OSG Digital Agency (OSGWeb.ge)

> ვებ სტუდია თბილისში: საიტის დამზადება, ვებ დიზაინი (UI/UX), ონლაინ მაღაზიები და SEO ოპტიმიზაცია ქართული ბიზნესებისთვის. Web design and development studio in Tbilisi, Georgia: custom websites, online stores, UI/UX design and SEO for Georgian businesses.

The website is in Georgian by default, with English and Russian versions available through the language switcher.

## სერვისები / Services

- [საიტის დამზადება / Website development](https://osgweb.ge/#services): custom, mobile-friendly business websites with basic SEO
- [ონლაინ მაღაზია / Online stores](https://osgweb.ge/#pricing): e-commerce and booking systems
- [ვებ დიზაინი (UI/UX) / Web design](https://osgweb.ge/#services): brand-tailored interfaces and user experience
- [ადმინ პანელი და CMS / Admin panel & CMS](https://osgweb.ge/#pricing): site management, analytics, Supabase / headless CMS
- [SEO ოპტიმიზაცია / SEO](https://osgweb.ge/#pricing): technical and on-page SEO, site speed optimization

## ფასები / Pricing (GEL, one-time payment)

- [სტარტერი / Starter — 1,200₾](https://osgweb.ge/#pricing): up to 3 pages, performance optimization, basic SEO
- [პრო / Pro — 2,500₾](https://osgweb.ge/#pricing): up to 5 pages, admin and analytics dashboard, CMS integration
- [პრემიუმი / Premium — 5,200₾](https://osgweb.ge/#pricing): up to 10 pages, e-commerce or booking system, full SEO audit, 3 months of post-launch support
- [ინდივიდუალური / Custom](https://osgweb.ge/#pricing): 10+ pages and complex API integrations, priced per project

Installment plans are available: 50/50, 3 months or 6 months.
